title: {\tau}-bench-LILT: Evaluating Conversational Agents on Realistic Multilingual Tool-Use Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier evaluations of tool-using conversational agents are conducted almost exclusively in English, leaving a critical gap for organizations deploying agents in other languages and regions. We present ${\tau}$-bench-LILT, a multilingual extension of ${\tau^3}$-bench covering German, Korean, Turkish, and Farsi in the airline, retail, telecom, and banking domains. We natively localize every layer of the benchmark: customer databases are populated with culturally appropriate records, user-simulator prompts are refined iteratively through contrastive annotation by native-language experts, and tasks are updated according to the localized database and to reflect realistic tasks in the target region. Evaluation across eight agent models shows the largest drops compared to English in the Korean and Farsi retail domains, by up to 61 points in pass^4. Code and data released at https://github.com/lilt/tau-bench-lilt.

translated_title: τ-bench-LILT：在真实的多语言工具使用任务上评估对话智能体
translated_abstract: 工具使用型对话智能体的前沿评估几乎完全在英文环境下进行，这给那些在其他语言和地区部署智能体的组织留下了关键性的空白。我们提出了τ-bench-LILT，这是τ³-bench的多语言扩展版本，涵盖德语、韩语、土耳其语和波斯语，涉及航空、零售、电信和银行四个领域。我们对基准测试的每一层都进行了彻底的本地化：客户数据库填充了符合当地文化的记录，用户模拟器提示词通过母语专家的对比标注进行迭代优化，任务则根据本地化数据库进行更新，以反映目标地区的真实任务场景。对八个智能体模型的评估显示，与英语相比，韩语和波斯语的零售领域性能下降最为严重，在pass^4指标上最多下降61分。代码和数据已在 https://github.com/lilt/tau-bench-lilt 发布。
tldr: 该论文提出了τ-bench-LILT——一个对数据库、用户模拟器和任务进行全面本地化的多语言工具使用基准，覆盖德语、韩语、土耳其语和波斯语，揭示了对话智能体在非英语场景下性能显著下降（最多61分）。
